snippet.title: I Cooked For EVERY Animal
snippet.description:
Watch to the end to see me cook for a lion!

Please read, because this is very important to me. Throughout this entire video, I worked with animal welfare experts and veterinarians to ensure that we only worked with the best animal habitats and fed the animals ingredients that already exist in their normal, everyday diets (as you’ll see, most dishes are simple and vegetable based). Many animals are mistreated around the world, so it was extremely important to me while making this video that we found organizations committed to giving the animals the best lives possible! The elephant sanctuary, for instance, rescues elephants that have been forced into some kind of heavy labor their entire lives and gives them a comfortable, safe, and happy retirement in the jungle for the rest of their lives. If you’re reading this, I’d highly encourage you to do your own research before visiting a zoo, aquarium, or anything similar to make sure they treat their animals humanely. I know nobody asked about any of this, but I think it’s important to use my platform to bring this to your attention since I learned a lot about animals while making this video.

snippet.title: Chocolate choco bar icecream recipe! ❤️#icecreamrecipe #chocolateicecream #recipe #dessert #fyp
snippet.description:
Chocolate Choco Bar Ice Cream (Childhood Memories in Every Bite)

Makes: 5 choco bar ice creams
You’ll need: 5 thin long Ziploc bags (or any slim plastic ice candy bags)

⸻

🟫 For the Chocolate Casing
 • 200 g dark chocolate (that crackling chocolate shell we used to wait for as kids)

🍫 For the Creamy Chocolate Filling
 • 500 g whipping cream
 • 40 g cocoa powder, sifted (light)
 • 1 tsp vanilla extract 
 • 200 g condensed milk (I used my homemade condensed milk) :)

⸻

Method

Step 1: Prepare the Chocolate Shell
 1. Melt the dark chocolate gently until smooth and glossy.
 2. Divide and pour the melted chocolate evenly into 5 Ziploc bags.
 3. Coat the inner sides of the bags by gently pressing and spreading the chocolate.
 4. Keep them aside to set slightly.

(That shiny chocolate layer = pure Magnum-style nostalgia.)

⸻

Step 2: Make the Chocolate Ice Cream Filling
 1. In a separate bowl, beat the whipping cream just until slightly thickened.
 • ❗ Do not whip to peaks — it should be thick but still soft and fluid.
 2. Add:
 • Sifted cocoa powder
 • Vanilla extract
 • Condensed milk
 3. Beat until completely smooth and combined.
 4. If you notice lumps, strain the mixture for a silky finish.
 5. The final mixture should be thin and pourable.
 • If it becomes too thick, microwave it in 5-second intervals, just until it loosens to a pouring consistency.

(Smooth like those melted chocolate bars we used to lick before they fully froze.)

⸻

Step 3: Fill & Freeze
 1. Pour the chocolate mixture into the prepared chocolate-lined bags.
 2. Seal properly.
 3. Freeze them in an upright position (not flat) for at least 4 hours, or until fully set.

(Waiting for them to freeze feels exactly like waiting after dinner for that one chocolate bar treat.)

⸻

Serving

Cut open the bag, slide it out, and enjoy.

Crack through that chocolate shell and hit the creamy center.
Better than store-bought Magnum ice creams.

This is pure childhood memories — amazing, mouth-watering, and dangerously good.

Try it to believe it. 🍫✨

A Faculdade Adventista do Paraná é uma instituição com internato que, há 85 anos, oferece diversas oportunidades aos seus alunos do ensino escolar e superior.

O Coral Canto Jovem é o coral do Ensino Médio e do Ensino Fundamental II do Colégio Adventista do Paraná. Com mais de 15 anos de história, o coral possui um vasto acervo de materiais produzidos. Ele conta com a participação de alunos internos e externos da Educação Básica da Faculdade Adventista do Paraná.

Nesta produção especial, o campus recebeu a participação da cantora Rayssa Andreoli na celebração dos 85 anos da instituição. Durante o evento, os alunos tiveram a oportunidade de interpretar, junto com ela, a música que está sendo desfrutada.

IMPERFEITO
Música: Gustavo Fernandes
Letra: Annelise Santana e Gustavo Fernandes

PARTITURAS E KITS
drive.google.com/drive/folders/1woIL-mO4w2smTpE9fSPTUlDbTUKTOPTL?usp=drive_link

Era uma vez... Eu
Dentro de casa, cansada do mesmo
E aconteceu

Bem dessa vez
Eu quis sair
Tudo lá fora atraía com brilho
E eu fugi

Depois dos portões sonhei:
Do mundo eu era rei
Podia escrever algo novo usando somente minhas mãos

Os sonhos que almejei
As coisas que desejei,
O que toquei, alcancei, possuí, me entreguei à ilusão
Mas sei que eu...

Que eu me perdi,
Tentando me encontrar (uuum!)
Foi tão profundo que o poço mais fundo não tem mais lugar pra ti!

Eu percebi (Un - hum)
Nada ganhei (Eu sei)
Os que amei, eu perdi, eu soltei, eu deixei para trás

Mas se eu tentar? (se tentar)
Se eu voltar? (se voltar)
Será que ainda há lugar?
Eu posso retomar minha direção?

Depois dos portões eu vi
O erro que cometi
O que conquistei posso ver escorrendo por entre minhas mãos

Os muros em construção
Pra mim eram proteção
Busquei liberdade, encontrei o perigo, hoje eu sou solidão
Hoje eu sou solidão

Voltarei para casa, essa é a solução
Vou andar, vou correr em sua direção
Eu cansei da odisseia movida à
Soberba presunção

Num instante, eu avisto o Pai se aproximar
Já não sei se há perdão, mas preciso tentar
Eu me lanço aos Seus pés, e começo a clamar

Nem sei como vou falar
Não sei se vais me aceitar
Pai, eu me humilho, me torno Teu servo, me deixa voltar?

Foi quando Ele me alcançou
Correndo me abraçou
Eu já era outro, mas Seu amor não mudou

Me disse que perdoou
Há muito me esperou
Se fez meu abrigo e a todos, disse o Pai:

Meu Filho voltou!

Eu não sei quão distante ou perdido estás, mas sei
Que Ele está a te esperar. Eu sei que
Mesmo que faltem forças e longe sentir
O Pai de amor te encontra;
Vida nova, enfim.

*****************************************

Rayssa Andreoli

snippet.title: Lacquer Dyeing Velvet Flowers – From Silk Cocoon to Colorful Blossom #handmade #craft #handcraft
snippet.description:
Lacquer-dyed velvet flowers are a traditional Chinese handicraft that combines natural silk with mineral pigments and lacquer techniques, creating delicate blossoms with rich colors and soft textures.

First, natural purple mineral pigment is mixed with lacquer, stirred thoroughly, and finely ground into a smooth paste. The mixture is then filtered through cotton cloth to produce pure dye. The same process is repeated for other colors.

Silk cocoons are heated and unwound into silk fibers, which are then soaked overnight in hot water with alkali to remove impurities. After rinsing and drying, the silk is combed, wound, and finely cut to form soft, fluffy fibers.

The silk is then folded, flattened, and carefully cut into flower shapes. Finally, each silk flower is dipped into the lacquer-based dyes to absorb vibrant colors, then dried and shaped. Through the artisan’s careful craftsmanship, the silk transforms into radiant velvet flowers — colorful, glossy, and full of life, embodying the beauty of traditional Chinese artistry.

snippet.title: My Hairline!" 🙏 Dre’s Most Dramatic Meltdown Ever | Black-ish S2E8#shorts
snippet.description:
"My nice, full, sweet, never-did-nothing-to-nobody hairline!" 😭🩹 Today, we are breaking down one of the most relatable and memed episodes of black-ish: Season 2, Episode 8, "Chop Shop." If you've ever had a bad haircut right before a major event, Dre Johnson’s pain is your pain.

In the world of Dre Johnson (Anthony Anderson), your barber is your life. He’s been loyal to his barber, T., through every stage of his life—from the "fourth-grade flat top" to the "graduation gumby." 🎓💇‍♂️

The Betrayal: When his son Junior decides to switch to a new barber (Smoke), Dre takes it as a personal insult to Black culture. To prove that loyalty is everything, Dre goes back to his old faithful, T.

The Massacre: The result? A disaster. T. leaves Dre with an uneven, receding hairline that looks like a battlefield. 🔥

The Family Roast: When Dre walks through the door, the Johnsons do what they do best: they tear him apart. From Bow’s shock to the kids' laughter, the reaction is brutal.

The "P'ehh" Heard 'Round the World: We get the debut of Diane’s iconic high-pitched "p'ehh" sound—the universal sound of a failed lineup.

The Breakdown: Dre’s prayer to "Black Jesus" over his missing hairline is a masterclass in physical comedy. With family photos coming up, Bow (Tracee Ellis Ross) suggests the only solution left: a Sharpie. 🖊️🖼️

This episode is a fan favorite because it touches on the deep-rooted tradition of the Black barbershop while delivering some of the sharpest roasts in the series. Dre’s dramatic monologue about the "funky fresh Driggity Dre" makes this an essential watch for any sitcom fan.

snippet.title: أكبر كيك بالعالم عشكل ناقة 🐪
snippet.description:
من قلبي… كل عام والمملكة وأهلها بألف خير 🇸🇦🤍

هالعمل مش بس كيكة، هيدي هديتي للمملكة، للبلد اللي بحبّه من قلبي، واللي كان جزء كبير من رحلتي ونجاحي.
اخترت الجمل، رمز الأصالة والصبر والعز، وحوّلته لعمل ضخم احتفالاً باليوم الوطني السعودي.

وبصراحة لما شفت النتيجة النهائية، تأثرت بطريقة ما كنت متوقعتها. 🥹
كل تفصيل، كل ساعة شغل، وكل التعب صار إلو معنى بهاللحظة.

فخورة جداً بهالمشروع، وأسعد إني أقدّمه كهدية بسيطة لبلد أعطاني الكثير. 🇸🇦

كل عام والسعودية عز وفخر… وكل عام وأهلها بألف خير. 💚🇸🇦

From my heart, Happy Saudi National Day to the Kingdom and to every Saudi. 🇸🇦🤍

This creation is more than just a cake… it is my gift to a country I truly love, a country that has been such a meaningful part of my journey and success.

I chose the camel , a symbol of heritage, strength, patience, and pride ,and transformed it into one of my biggest creations in celebration of Saudi National Day.

Seeing the final result moved me more than I expected. 🥹
Every detail, every hour of work, and every challenge behind this project suddenly felt worth it.

I’m incredibly proud of this creation and honored to dedicate it to a Kingdom that has given me so much. 🇸🇦

Happy Saudi National Day. May Saudi Arabia always remain a land of pride, ambition, and beautiful stories. 💚🇸🇦

snippet.title: 2M에 달하는 오오타치를 발도하는 방법들
snippet.description:
📍영상출처: @全球不知道 @-asayamaichidenkai-161 @tenshinryu 

2m에 가까운 오오타치(대태도)는 일반적인 발도술로는 쉽게 뽑을 수 없는 거대한 일본도였습니다. 상황에 따라 시종에게 칼을 건네받거나, 독특한 발도법을 활용해 전투에 임했습니다. 
오오타치를 다루기 위해 고안된 일본 사무라이들의 독특한 발도술을 이 영상에서 확인해 볼 수 있습니다.

영상이 마음에 드셨다면 구독&좋아요 부탁해요!
오늘도 시청해 주셔서 감사합니다.

#사무라이 #발도술 #검술 #battojutsu #swordskills #odachi #nodachi #kenjutsu #martialarts #japanesesword #longsword #오다치 #오오타치 #노다치

✅본 채널은 검술의 원리, 검의 구조와 사용법, 안전 수칙, 형·대련 훈련, 무기 위협 상황 대응 및 제압 기술, 관련 장비에 대한 이해를 돕기 위한 교육 및 정보 제공 목적으로 콘텐츠를 제작하고 있습니다.

본 채널에서 제작하는 모든 검술 영상은 여러 국가와 유파에서 전승되는 검술의 특징, 동작 원리, 수련 목적을 교육적인 관점에서 소개합니다. 

검술 수련은 자세와 거리 조절, 신체 균형, 집중력, 반응 능력 등을 기르고, 심신을 수련하기 위한 전통 무예 훈련의 하나입니다.

영상에 등장하는 모든 검술 동작, 발도 시연, 형 수련, 대련 및 베기 시범은 관련 규정과 안전 절차를 준수하여 진행되었으며, 허가된 도장이나 안전하게 통제된 환경에서 숙련된 전문가와 안전 요원의 감독하에 촬영되었습니다. 

본 콘텐츠는 검술의 역사와 기술적 원리에 대한 교육·정보 제공을 위한 것으로, 일반인의 무분별한 모방이나 위험한 재현을 권장하지 않습니다.

본 콘텐츠는 검의 구조와 사용 원리, 검술의 동작, 거리와 타이밍, 무기 위협 상황에 대응하는 전통 무예의 훈련 방식을 이해하기 위한 목적으로 제작되었습니다. 폭력, 범죄, 불법적인 무기 사용 또는 위험 행위를 조장하거나 미화하려는 의도는 전혀 없습니다.

또한 영상 속 모든 장면은 철저한 안전 관리가 이루어진 환경에서 촬영되었습니다. 시청자 여러분께서는 검이나 유사 도구를 함부로 사용하지 마시고, 반드시 관련 법규와 안전 수칙을 준수하시기 바랍니다. 

본 채널은 유튜브 커뮤니티 가이드라인 및 광고 친화 정책을 준수하여 운영됩니다.

snippet.title: Making Spicy Stir-Fried Vegetable Noodles🍜
snippet.description:
[My Content Creation Note]
I completely handle this channel by myself. This video is the result of my own creative thinking, starting with the story idea, writing down the script, and doing all the clip adjustments step-by-step. I spend hours cutting the video parts, shifting speeds, and using different visual look-and-feel adjustments in my editor to make sure it is a fully handmade creation.

Welcome to Ghibli Kitchen ASMR! In this short video, we are making a delicious, quick plate of stir-fried vegetable noodles. We will use crisp ingredients directly picked from the garden and toss them in a hot pan with a few basic savory sauces.

Sit back and relax with the soothing sounds of fresh vegetables being sliced, water bubbling, and ingredients sizzling on the fire.

[What Happens In This Video]
- Picking up clean, fresh greens directly from the backyard garden
- Slicing and chopping the colorful vegetables into neat, thin pieces
- Boiling the noodles perfectly so they stay soft and separate
- Adding a tiny bit of cooking oil to a heated open pan
- Tossing the chopped greens on high flame to keep them crunchy
- Pouring a splash of dark soy sauce and mixed dry spices for the taste
- Flipping and combining everything together until hot and ready
- Enjoying the final meal near the window while a cute little cat sits nearby

[Sound Mix Info]
The audio track combines the real, close-up sounds of the cooking process with my own whispering background sound recorded at low volume to give you a comforting and original experience.
